entries.message: This update includes improve watch state, season mapping and presentation, confirm Plex unwatch against live metadata and sync cached episode state, tighten TV match picker layout, and clarify Plex unwatch confirmation.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Preserve completed Plex watch state across stale resume data and protect unwatch races.
Add TV season source selection, episode translation, unmatched episode handling, and translated Up Next warmup.
Preserve Trakt-only plays during show replacement and fail closed on occupied targets.
Split sync, history import, polling, and scheduling work into focused modules with retry and lease safeguards.
Improve appearance controls, changelog navigation, Reddit release bundling, and README screenshots.
Plex unwatch detection now re-checks live metadata before treating an episode as unwatched, so a watched episode is no longer wrongly sent to manual watch review.
Keep season-source switching and its watch-impact confirmation close to search controls.
Reduce Fix Match whitespace on phone, tablet, and desktop while preserving movie and TV results.
Use neutral empty-season copy when provider episode lists are unavailable.
Explain that suspected Plex unwatches are checked against live metadata before manual watch review.
messageFragments: Feature - Improve watch state, season mapping and presentation
Fix - Confirm Plex unwatch against live metadata and sync cached episode state
Fix - Tighten TV match picker layout
